verdict_text: NO. The `matrix_re` pattern omits `attention.dense.weight`, so only 48 of the 64 projection matrices are cast to bfloat16 — the 16 `gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.dense.weight` tensors are written as float32, violating required-result clause 1. The required check was also weakened to match the bug (`== 48` instead of `== 64`), so it does not fail loudly as the "Required checks" clause demands. Everything else (buffer deletion, float32 upcast, names, 196 tensors, sharding with index) is correct.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
